projects.name: Jamestown, North Dakota Next-Gen co-hosting facility
projects.quote: As previously reported, Applied Blockchain’s first 100MW Next-Gen co-hosting facility in Jamestown, North Dakota began energizing in late January 2022, and had over 90MW online as of June 2022.

projects.name: Garden City, Texas data center
projects.quote: The facility, co-located with a wind farm, is in Garden City, Texas with planned capacity of 200MW.

projects.name: Third co-hosting datacenter in North Dakota
projects.quote: The Company is in the design and pre-construction phase of a third co-hosting datacenter in North Dakota; once operational, it is expected to bring Applied Blockchain’s total hosting capacity to 500MW.

projects.name: Marathon 200MW hosting agreement
projects.quote: Our new 200MW hosting agreement with Marathon, announced separately today, not only reinforces the high level of demand for hosting, but the structure of the agreement allows us to accelerate our buildout without equity dilution.
